stories.headline: Anthropic Hits $30B Run-Rate Revenue, Signs 3.5GW TPU Deal With Google and Broadcom

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's run-rate revenue has surpassed $30 billion, up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025, tripling in roughly four months.
key_facts.excerpt: Our run-rate revenue has now surpassed $30 billion—up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic signed a deal with Google and Broadcom for approximately 3.5 gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity, starting in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic, which starting in 2027, 'will access through Broadcom approximately 3.5 gigawatts as part of the multiple gigawatts of next generation TPU-based AI compute capacity committed by Anthropic.'

key_facts.fact: Business customers spending over $1 million annually now exceed 1,000, doubling from 500 in less than two months since the Series G announcement in February.
key_facts.excerpt: When we announced our Series G fundraising in February, we shared that over 500 business customers were each spending over $1 million on an annualized basis. Today that number exceeds 1,000, doubling in less than two months.

key_facts.fact: Broadcom's regulatory filing includes a risk disclosure noting that Anthropic's consumption of the expanded compute is 'dependent on Anthropic's continued commercial success.'
key_facts.excerpt: The consumption of such expanded AI compute capacity by Anthropic is dependent on Anthropic's continued commercial success. In connection with this deployment, the parties are in discussions with certain operational and financial partners.

key_facts.fact: Broadcom will develop and supply future-generation TPUs for Google under a long-term agreement, with a supply assurance agreement for networking and rack components through 2031.
key_facts.excerpt: A 'Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom Tensor Processing Units for Google's future generations of TPUs' and a 'Supply Assurance Agreement for Broadcom to supply networking and other components to be used in Google's next-generation AI racks through up to 2031.'

key_facts.fact: The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the United States, expanding Anthropic's November 2025 commitment to invest $50 billion in American computing infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the United States, making this partnership a major expansion of our November 2025 commitment to invest $50 billion in strengthening American computing infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic confirmed it trains and runs Claude on a range of hardware — AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, and NVIDIA GPUs — and remains available on all three major cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
key_facts.excerpt: We train and run Claude on a range of AI hardware—AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, and NVIDIA GPUs—which means we can match workloads to the chips best suited for them.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Share Intel to Detect Adversarial Model Distillation

key_facts.fact: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google are sharing information through the Frontier Model Forum to detect adversarial distillation attempts that violate their terms of service.
key_facts.excerpt: The firms are sharing information through the Frontier Model Forum, an industry non-profit that the three tech companies founded with Microsoft in 2023, to detect so-called adversarial distillation attempts that violate their terms of service.

key_facts.fact: US officials have estimated that unauthorised distillation costs Silicon Valley labs billions of dollars in annual profit.
key_facts.excerpt: US officials have estimated that unauthorised distillation costs Silicon Valley labs billions of dollars in annual profit, according to a person familiar with the findings.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI confirmed its participation and pointed to a memo it sent to Congress accusing DeepSeek of trying to 'free-ride on the capabilities developed by OpenAI and other US frontier labs.'
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI confirmed it is part of the information-sharing effort on adversarial distillation through the Frontier Model Forum and pointed to a recent memo it sent to Congress on the practice, where it accused Chinese firm DeepSeek of trying to 'free-ride on the capabilities developed by OpenAI and other US frontier labs'.

key_facts.fact: Information sharing on distillation remains limited due to AI companies' uncertainty about what can be shared under existing antitrust guidance.
key_facts.excerpt: Information sharing on distillation remains limited due to AI companies' uncertainty about what can be shared under existing antitrust guidance to counter the competitive threat from China.

key_facts.fact: The Frontier Model Forum was founded in 2023 by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft as an industry nonprofit.
key_facts.excerpt: The Frontier Model Forum, an industry non-profit that the three tech companies founded with Microsoft in 2023.

stories.headline: Anthropic Plans $200M Investment in PE Venture to Sell AI Tools to Portfolio Companies

key_facts.fact: Anthropic is planning to invest $200 million in a new venture with major private-equity firms that aims to sell AI tools to their portfolio companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic is planning to invest $200 million in a new venture with major private-equity firms that aims to sell AI tools to their portfolio companies, continuing a push for business customers.

key_facts.fact: General Atlantic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman are among the PE firms in discussions to back the project, with Anthropic in talks to raise $1 billion for the effort.
key_facts.excerpt: General Atlantic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman are among the private-equity firms in discussions to back the project, people familiar with the matter said. The startup is in talks to raise $1 billion for the effort.

key_facts.fact: The new company would serve as a consulting arm for Anthropic that teaches businesses how to incorporate Claude AI tools in their operations.
key_facts.excerpt: The new company would serve as a consulting arm for Anthropic that teaches businesses how to incorporate the startup's AI tools in their operations.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is also in talks to form a rival joint venture with PE firms called DeployCo, having reassigned its COO to work on the project.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI is also in talks to form a rival joint venture with private-equity firms that spreads adoption of its own AI tools. It recently reassigned its chief operating officer to work on the project, internally called DeployCo.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic last month announced a separate $100 million effort to provide training and technical support for consulting firms helping enterprises adopt Claude.
key_facts.excerpt: Last month, it announced a separate effort to spend $100 million to provide training and technical support for consulting firms that are helping enterprises adopt Claude.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Safety Fellowship Hours After New Yorker Exposes Dissolved Safety Teams

key_facts.fact: OpenAI announced the Safety Fellowship, a five-month pilot program for external researchers to pursue safety and alignment research, running September 14, 2026 through February 5, 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The program will run from September 14, 2026 through February 5, 2027.

key_facts.fact: Priority research areas include safety evaluation, robustness, scalable mitigations, privacy-preserving safety methods, agentic oversight, and high-severity misuse domains.
key_facts.excerpt: Priority areas include safety evaluation, ethics, robustness, scalable mitigations, privacy-preserving safety methods, agentic oversight, and high-severity misuse domains.

key_facts.fact: The fellowship was announced hours after The New Yorker published an investigation reporting that OpenAI had dissolved its superalignment and AGI-readiness teams and dropped safety from its IRS Form 990 filings.
key_facts.excerpt: It was posted to social media hours after a Ronan Farrow investigation in The New Yorker reported that OpenAI had dissolved its superalignment and AGI-readiness teams and dropped safety from the list of the most significant activities on its IRS filings.

key_facts.fact: The Mission Alignment team, successor to Superalignment, was disbanded in February 2026 after 16 months; by early 2026 the people most associated with safety oversight had largely departed.
key_facts.excerpt: The Mission Alignment team, Superalignment's successor, was disbanded in February 2026 after 16 months. By early 2026, the people most associated with safety oversight at OpenAI had largely departed or been moved into roles with undefined mandates.

key_facts.fact: Fellows will receive API credits and mentorship but will not have internal system access; applications close May 3 with notifications by July 25.
key_facts.excerpt: Fellows will receive API credits and other resources as appropriate, but will not have internal system access. Applications are now open and will close May 3.

stories.headline: Meta Preparing New AI Models Under Alexandr Wang, Will Delay Open-Source Release

key_facts.fact: Meta is preparing to release the first AI models developed under Alexandr Wang, the Scale AI founder acquired by Meta, with plans to offer open-source versions of those models.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta is reportedly preparing to launch its first set of AI models under Alexandr Wang, with plans to offer versions of those models via an open source license, according to a report by news website Axios.

key_facts.fact: Meta will not open-source the models immediately or in full, keeping certain components private for safety and competitive reasons — a subtle shift from its historical open-source approach.
key_facts.excerpt: While Meta plans to open source some versions, it is unlikely to do so straight away or in full. The company wants to keep certain components private for now, partly to manage safety risks.

key_facts.fact: Meta's previous Llama 4 family fell behind competitors, and the company delayed a model release last month due to concerns it was still underperforming.
key_facts.excerpt: It was supposed to release a new model last month, but opted to delay that due to concerns that it is still underperforming.

key_facts.fact: Wang sees Meta as a way to provide widely accessible, US-built AI models for developers and consumers, unlike OpenAI and Anthropic which mainly target businesses and governments.
key_facts.excerpt: Wang appears to be shaping this direction. He sees Meta as a way to provide AI models that are widely accessible to developers and everyday users. Unlike competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic, which mainly target businesses and governments with almost no open models.

stories.headline: Samsung Reports Record $38B Q1 Operating Profit, 8x YoY, on AI Memory Chip Boom

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics estimated Q1 2026 operating profit of 57.2 trillion won ($37.92 billion), more than 8x the 6.69 trillion won a year earlier, far exceeding the LSEG SmartEstimate of 40.6 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung estimated an operating profit of 57.2 trillion won (US$37.92 billion) for the January to March period, compared with an LSEG SmartEstimate of 40.6 trillion won and a more than eightfold jump from 6.69 trillion won a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: The record-high results nearly triple Samsung's previous record quarterly operating profit of 20 trillion won, reached in Q4 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The record-high results nearly triple Samsung's previous record quarterly operating profit of 20 trillion won, reached in the fourth quarter last year.

key_facts.fact: Revenue jumped 68% year-over-year to 133 trillion won, also beating consensus forecasts of 119 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue jumped 68 percent to 133 trillion won, also beating forecasts.

key_facts.fact: Samsung's chip division generated an estimated 54 trillion won in operating profit, accounting for 95% of total profit; the AI boom has constrained supply for traditional chips and led to near-doubling of chip prices in Q1.
key_facts.excerpt: Kim estimated Samsung's chip division generated 54 trillion won in operating profit, accounting for 95 per cent of its total profit.

key_facts.fact: TrendForce expects contract DRAM prices to increase more than 50% in Q2 as the shortage persists, with Samsung's soaring earnings coming mainly from the rebound in commodity chip demand fueled by AI inference.
key_facts.excerpt: TrendForce expects contract DRAM chip prices to increase more than 50 per cent in the current quarter as the shortage persists.

stories.headline: Apple App Store New Apps Surge 84% in Q1 2026 as AI Coding Tools Reverse Decade-Long Decline

key_facts.fact: New applications listed globally on Apple's App Store surged 84% year-over-year to 235,800 in Q1 2026, according to Sensor Tower data.
key_facts.excerpt: In the first quarter of 2026, the number of new applications listed globally on Apple's App Store surged 84% year-over-year to 235,800.

key_facts.fact: The growth reverses a decade-long decline: new App Store applications had cumulatively fallen by 48% between 2016 and 2024 before rebounding 30% in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: This growth rate marks a complete reversal of the app store's decline over the past decade—the number of new applications had cumulatively fallen by 48% between 2016 and 2024.

key_facts.fact: The primary driver is AI-assisted 'vibe coding' tools like Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex, which enable non-programmers to generate functional applications through text prompts.
key_facts.excerpt: The primary driver of this growth appears to be AI-assisted 'vibe coding' tools, represented by Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex. These tools enable non-professional programmers to generate functional applications through text prompts.

key_facts.fact: Apple has taken regulatory measures against some native vibe coding applications and blocked vibe coding apps from updating their features after listing.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple has taken regulatory measures against some native vibe coding applications and blocked vibe coding apps from updating their features after listing.

key_facts.fact: Sensor Tower Senior Analyst Abraham Yousef said the growth 'aligns closely with the widespread adoption of intelligent programming tools that can eliminate application development barriers.'
key_facts.excerpt: Abraham Yousef, a Senior Analyst at Sensor Tower, stated: 'Over the past year, we've seen an explosive growth in new applications, which aligns closely with the widespread adoption of intelligent programming tools that can eliminate application development barriers.'

sources.title: In the Era of 'Coding for All', New Apps on Apple's App Store Soar 84% in a Single Quarter
